decision: Store post-merge pr.outcome records in a fixed pr-outcomes.jsonl synthetic-runId log; origin context (prNumber/branch/issue/originRunId) lives in meta, no per-run join
alternatives: ALSO persist a run->PR map at PR-create time in finalize to enable true per-run correlation later
require caller to pass originating runId at merge time
reasoning: first signal outside a live run; per-run correlation needs run->PR persist infra that does not exist today (state.json has no prNumber and is reset each run); fixed-log is feasible now via RUN_ID_RE allowing pr-outcomes runId, but bends one-file=one-run
risk: precedent-setting; report must NOT treat pr-outcomes.jsonl as a pipeline run for duration/phase math

decision: luca pr-outcome takes explicit flags only (prNumber/result/reviewRounds/timeToMergeMs/branch?/issue?/originRunId?); deterministic, fully tested, no gh coupling
alternatives: explicit flags + optional gh pr view derivation fallback for omitted values
reasoning: review-round count is not a first-class gh field (heuristic); explicit flags are the clean tested path; the handler unit test asserts the JSONL round-trip deterministically
risk: gh coupling + non-determinism if derivation is made primary; CI/user must compute reviewRounds themselves

decision: Single new TelemetryKind 'pr.outcome'; merged-vs-reverted carried in meta.result not separate kinds; no schema v bump (open union + free-form meta absorb the new shape)
reasoning: schema is open union | (string & {}) and meta is z.record free-form; result is an attribute of one event, not two event types; v:1 stays LOCKED per research
risk: report must add an explicit accumulator or pr.outcome lands in Unknown kinds tally

decision: Mirror luca-confidence-log pattern: handler ToolDescriptor in write-surface/handlers/luca-pr-outcome.ts, barrel-export it, citty leaf under telemetryCommand.subCommands as 'pr-outcome'; handler calls appendTelemetry with ctx.runId='pr-outcomes'
reasoning: pr.outcome IS a telemetry record so the verb belongs under telemetry; appendTelemetry+generateRunId already barrel-exported, no new export plumbing
risk: stage-gate or rejectUnknownFlags wiring drift if leaf not mirrored exactly
